Life Orb: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of all moves by 30% at the cost of 10% of its HP each time it attacks.
Power Herb: A single-use item to be held by a Pokémon. It allows the holder to immediately use a move that normally requires a turn to charge.
Toxic Orb: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a bizarre orb that will badly poison the holder during battle.
Flame Orb: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a bizarre orb that will afflict the holder with a burn during battle.
Ultra Space Dust: A rare residue collected from Ultra Wormholes. Ditto gains 2x Speed and 1.5x Sp. Atk when not transformed- or 25% to all stats when transformed.
Focus Sash: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder has full HP, it will endure a potential KO attack with 1 HP. The item then disappears.
Toxic Vanity: A mirror that feeds Unfezant's ego further. It grants the benefits of Pixilate & Moxie- but this comes at a cost- inflicting Defeatist & Toxic.
Metronome: If held by Chatot or the Kricketune line, boosts the power of moves used consecutively by 35% maxing out at 2x damage. (1x, 1.35x, 1.70x, 2x)
Pig Iron: Molten-hot steelworking scraps cherished by the Grumpig line. Grants Incinerate, Loaded Dice, +1 crit rate, Filter & blocks secondary move effects.
Lagging Tail: This heavy tail blocks the holder from being phased out of battle by Roar, Whirlwind & Circle Throw. In exchange, they move last within their priority bracket.
Covert Cloak: This hooded cloak conceals the holder, tricking the eyes of its enemies and protecting it from the additional effects of moves.
Black Sludge: This now heals Poison types by 12% HP per turn, DOUBLE what it was previously. It still damages non-Poison types as well.
Icy Rock: Extends the duration of snow by 3 turns. If held by the Feraligatr line, they also heal 1/6 in snow, and ignore secondary move effects and critical hits.
Smooth Rock: Extends the duration of sand by 3 turns. If held by the Crustle line: Rock Head, status/stat drop immunity in sand & sets Stealth Rock when hit by physical moves.
Heat Rock: Extends the duration of sun by 3 turns. If held by the Gigalith line, also gains a 1/4 Fire resist, burn & secondary effect immunity, and heals 1/6 in sun.
Damp Rock: Extends the duration of rain by 3 turns. If held by Relicanth, it gains Rock Head, buffed Rain Dish, and immunity to secondary effects of moves.
Rotten Egg: A once cherished egg has utterly spoiled. When held, Blissey gains the effects of Merciless, Poisonous and Liquid Ooze. It smells vile.
Choice Scarf: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts Speed by 50%, but forces the use of one move.
Prickly Pear: A thorny fruit to be held by the Cacturne line & Maractus. Grants immunity to status/stat drops in sand, & passive Rocky Helmet+Crit immunity.
Clear Amulet: This clear, sparkling amulet protects the holder from having its stats lowered by moves used against it or by other Pokémon's Abilities.
Power Belt: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder's Defense stat to grow more after battling.
Power Lens: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder's Sp. Atk stat to grow more after battling.
Trash Bag: Rancid garbage that the Trubbish & A-Grimer lines love to eat. Grants Black Sludge, Covert Cloak, Poisonous, Liquid Ooze & Aftermath.
Graham Cracker: A crunchy treat the S'Muk line munches for 6% HP each turn (2x w/Appetite). Blocks secondary effects & deals 6% chip damage if the cracker is touched.
Scaly Hood: When worn by the Scrafty line, they become poisoned, ignore crits, secondary effects & all passive damage, & take 1/4 from Fairy & Poison.
Shed Shell: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This discarded carapace enables the holder to switch out of battle without fail.
Big Root: Now boosts the HP drained from draining moves by 50%. Works for typical HP draining moves such as Giga Drain, but also Leech Seed, Strength Sap & Ingrain.
Choice Specs: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These curious glasses boost Sp. Atk by 50%, but force use of one move.
Cracked Compass: Machoke's compass once used to navigate the jungle. When held, it grants a 50% Grass boost, Wide Lens, Covert Cloak, & a 50% resist to Bug, Poison & Grass.
Desert Cloak: A light, heat resistant cloak fashioned by Throh to survive harsh deserts. When worn, it grants a 50% Fire resist, Covert Cloak, and buffed Sand Force.
Arctic Coat: A thick fur coat Sawk crafted to survive in the harsh cold of the tunda. When worn, it grants Covert Cloak, Ice Body and Refrigerate.
Meadow Plate: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a stone tablet that boosts the power of Grass moves by 20%.
Icicle Plate: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ice moves by 20%.
Coconut: A tough, unripe coconut. Passimian or Exeggutor gain a 50% Grass damage boost & are protected from critical hits & recoil. Chimpeace > Chimpower.
Toxic Plate: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison moves by 20%.
Earth Plate: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ground moves by 20%.
Leaf Fan: Oranguru or Shiftry gain a 50% Grass/Flying boost & Grassy Guard. Shiftry gains +1 crit rate. Oranguru gains Analytic. Swaps Chimpower to Chimpeace.
Wooden Log: When held by Komala or Timburr, grants a 50% Grass boost, Grassy Guard, Covert Cloak & immunity to phasing. Komala also gains Headstrong & Filter.
Sandy Stinger: If wielded by Skorupi or Drapion, this grants +1 crit rate, Poison STAB & resistance, Sand Force and Stakeout- in exchange for badly poisoning itself.
Concrete Pillar: A heavy block of concrete to be held by Conkeldurr. Grants a 50% Rock boost, the effects of the ability Beatdown, Covert Cloak & immunity to phasing.
Liepard Pelt: When worn by Machamp or Liepard, it acts as Covert Cloak. Liepard gains Fur Coat, while Machamp gains +1 offensive stats when hit by a Dark type move.
Draco Plate: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dragon moves by 20%.
Poison Ivy: Grants the Serperior line the effects of Poisonous & Poison Heal, and poisons the holder. Also grants Poison STAB and immunity to Poison type moves.
Solar Panel: Allows Butterfree to infinitely fire 2 turn moves such as Solar Beam without charging up. In the sun, they gain 50% Sp. Atk- but lose 1/8 HP per turn.
Frozen Crown: When worn by Tyrantrum or Slaking, this crown grants immunity to critical hits and allows them to bypass various abilities when attacking.
Rock Incense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense boosts the power of Rock-type moves by 20%.
Full Incense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense makes the holder bloated and slow moving.
Bubble-Tron: A bubble-making gadget. If held by the Wailord line, Pyukumuku, Octillery, Qwilfish or Corsola- they gain (buffed) Full Metal Body & Rain Dish.
Rainbow Charm: A radiant pendant that allows the Furret line to draw more power from rainbows. Unlocks Prism Armor, Showstopper, Solar Power & Rain Dish.
Luck Incense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles any prize money received if the holding Pokémon joins a battle.
Pure Incense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the head of the party.
Protector: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. If held by Rhyperior, it gains Solid Rock, and ignores secondary effects & phasing moves.
Electirizer: A cryptic machine bursting with electricity. This helps Electabuzz evolve. If held by Electivire, it gains Teravolt & Motor Drive.
Magmarizer: A cryptic machine bursting with heat. This helps Magmar evolve. If held by Magmortar, it gains Turboblaze and Flash Fire.
Dubious Disc: If held by Porygon-Z, it gains: Psychic, Steel & Bug STAB, becomes Infectious, 50% Speed boost if under half HP, & switches out (one time) if stats are lowered.
Reaper Cloth: If held by the Duskull line, gains a 50% Ghost boost, resist + Covert Cloak. Dusknoir also absorbs souls for 50% of damage dealt, and is immune to crits.
Frozen Claw: When held by Alolan Sandslash, Beartic or the Sneasel line, they gain Refrigerate and +1 crit rate. Sandslash also gains (buffed) Iron Barbs.
Toxic Claw: Grants +1 crit rate & 50% Bug boost if held by the Gligar line, Sandslash or Scolipede. Gligar line are Poisonous. Others get Toxic Debris+Rocky Helmet.

Explorer Kit: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground in the Sinnoh region.
Loot Sack: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry any treasures or loot obtained in the coal mine.
Rule Book: It lists the rules for holding battles. For Link Battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.
Poké Radar: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in the tall grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.
Point Card: A card that lists how many Battle Points you have earned.
Journal: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.
Seal Case: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the exteriors of Poké Balls.
Fashion Case: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.
Seal Bag: A tiny bag that can hold 10 Seals for decorating Poké Balls.
Pal Pad: A convenient notepad that is used to register your Friends and friend codes and keep a record of your gameplay.
Works Key: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.
Old Charm: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.
Galactic Key: A card key for disengaging the security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.
Red Chain: A mythical chain that is said to link the Legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.
Town Map: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.
Vs. Seeker: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.
Coin Case: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It can hold up to 50,000 coins.
Old Rod: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
Good Rod: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
Super Rod: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
Sprayduck: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.
Poffin Case: A case for storing Poffins cooked from Berries.
Bike: A folding Bike that enables a rider to get around much faster than with Running Shoes.
Suite Key: A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.
Oak's Letter: A letter from Professor Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Route 224.
Lunar Wing: A feather that glows like the moon. It's said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.
Member Card: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.
Azure Flute: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. No one knows who made it.
S.S. Ticket: A ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on its front.
Contest Pass: A pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on its front.
Magma Stone: A stone formed by boulders melting in intensely hot magma, then hardening. Magma remains sealed inside it.
Parcel: A parcel entrusted into your care. You're supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.
Coupon 1: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
Coupon 2: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
Coupon 3: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
Storage Key: The key to Team Galactic's sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.
Secret Potion: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.
Vs. Recorder: An amazing device that can record a battle between friends or the battles at certain special battle facilities.
Enchanted Flower: A blossom of gratitude that is said never to wilt. Changes Flabébé, Floette, and Florges's colors. At Lv. 40, it awakens Shaymin and Floette's power.
Secret Key: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electronic signal to open a door.
Apricorn Box: A handy box where you can store up to 99 of each kind of Apricorn.
Unown Report: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.
Berry Pots: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.
Dowsing Machine: This high-tech machine shows the location of invisible items. It's attached to the head when in use.
Blue Card: A card to save points for the Buena's Password show.
Slowpoke Tail: A very tasty tail of something. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
Clear Bell: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.
Card Key: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.
Basement Key: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.
Squirt Bottle: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.
Red Scale: A scale from a red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.
Lost Item: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.
Pass: A pass required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you'd like.
Machine Part: An important part of a machine that was stolen from the Power Plant.
Silver Wing: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.
Rainbow Wing: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.
Mystery Egg: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What is in the Egg is unknown.
Red Apricorn: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.
Blue Apricorn: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.
Yellow Apricorn: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.
Green Apricorn: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.
Pink Apricorn: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.
White Apricorn: A white Apricorn. It doesn't smell like anything.
Black Apricorn: A black Apricorn. It has a scent beyond one's experience.
Fast Ball: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are usually very quick to run away.
Level Ball: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are at a lower level than your own Pokémon.
Lure Ball: A Poké Ball that is good for catching Pokémon that you reel in with a rod while out fishing.
Heavy Ball: A Poké Ball that is better than usual at catching very heavy Pokémon.
Love Ball: A Poké Ball that works best when catching a Pokémon that is of the opposite gender of your Pokémon.
Friend Ball: A strange Poké Ball that will make the wild Pokémon caught with it more friendly toward you immediately.
Moon Ball: A Poké Ball that will make it easier to catch Pokémon that can evolve using a Moon Stone.
Sport Ball: A special Poké Ball that is used during the Bug-Catching Contest.
Park Ball: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.
Photo Album: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.
GB Sounds: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It's operated with the flip of a single switch.
Tidal Bell: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.
Rage Candy Bar: Mahogany Town's famous candy. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

Fairium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Fairy-type moves to Z-Moves.
Light Ball: A ball teeming with electricity. When held by Pikachu, it grants a 50% boost to their offensive stats & a passive damage immunity. Arcanine line gains Showstopper.
Bottle Cap: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a silver gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.
Gold Bottle Cap: For use postgame only. Give these to Mr. Hyper, located in Hau'oli Mall to max out your IVs. This will help immensely for the postgame.
Z-Ring: A mysterious ring that enables Pokémon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.
Decidium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Decidueye's Spirit Shackle to a Z-Move.
Incinium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Incineroar's Darkest Lariat to a Z-Move.
Primarium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Primarina's Sparkling Aria to a Z-Move.
Tapunium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades the tapu's Nature's Madness to a Z-Move.
Marshadium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Marshadow's Spectral Thief to a Z-Move.
Aloraichium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Alolan Raichu's Thunderbolt to a Z-Move.
Snorlium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Snorlax's Giga Impact to a Z-Move.
Eevium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Eevee's Last Resort to a Z-Move.
Mewnium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Mew's Psychic to a Z-Move.
Pikashunium Z: It converts Z-Power into crystals that upgrade a Thunderbolt by Pikachu in a cap to an exclusive Z-Move.
Forage Bag: A bag to carry ingredients gathered during Mallow's trial in the jungle.
Fishing Rod: A fishing rod made by Captain Lana. Cast a line over piles of underwater rocks to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
Professor's Mask: The mask that belongs to The Masked Royal. This pro wrestler apparently sews his mask on a machine himself.
Festival Ticket: A ticket that allows you to host a mission in Festival Plaza.
Sparkling Stone: A stone entrusted by a Pokémon that has been venerated as a guardian deity in the Alola region. There is said to be some secret in how it sparkles.
Eject Pack: This emergency pack swaps the holder out of battle whenever its stats are lowered. Works once, then disappears.
Zygarde Cube: An item to store Zygarde Cores and Cells. Use it to teach Zygarde moves or change its form. More forms unlock as Zygarde levels up.
Ice Stone: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable snowflake pattern.
Ride Pager: By entering certain numbers on this pager, you can summon Ride Pokémon in an instant.
Beast Ball: A special Poké Ball designed to catch Ultra Beasts. If held by Electrode, it gains Static, Electric STAB and can be consumed to charge a 2 turn move.
Big Malasada: The Alola region's local specialty—fried bread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
Red Nectar: A flower nectar obtained at Ula'ula Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
Yellow Nectar: A flower nectar obtained at Melemele Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
Pink Nectar: The flower nectar obtained at the flowering shrubs on Royal Avenue. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
Purple Nectar: A flower nectar obtained at Poni Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
Sun Flute: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the sun.
Moon Flute: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the moon.
Enigmatic Card: A mysterious card. Written on it is a request for you to go to a guest room in an Akala motel on Route 8.
Climate Controller: A capsule that simulates changing seasons, weather, and biomes. Use it to change the form of Deerling, Sawsbuck, or Burmy.
Move Reminder: Use this strange device to allow a Pokémon to remember a move from available moves.
Pocket Center: A seemingly never-ending stockpile of medicine. Use it to heal your team fully at your convenience.
Rotom Catalog: A catalog full of appliances that Rotom love. Use it to change a Rotom's form. Each use switches it to the next appliance.
Furfrou Shears: Grooming scissors made for Furfrou. Use them to give a Furfrou a new trim. Each use switches it to the next style.
Terrain Extender: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the terrain caused by the holder's move or Ability.
Hard Scale: Tough armor made from Golisopod molts. When worn, they gain Multiscale, +1 crit rate, and ignore passive damage and contact-based drawbacks.
Electric Seed: Consumed under Electric Terrain to boost Sp. Def. Tapu Bibi/Koko & Cherrim Overcast (no Rise & Shine) summon terrain when attacked first.
Psychic Seed: Consumed under Psychic Terrain to boost Sp. Def. Tapu Bibi/Lele, Exeggcute & Kanto Exeggutor also summon terrain when attacked, boosting after.
Misty Seed: Consumed under Misty Terrain to boost Sp. Def. Tapu Bibi/Fini and Shiinotic line also summon terrain when attacked, boosting stats afterwards.
Grassy Seed: Consumed under Grassy Terrain to boost Sp. Def. Tapu Bibi/Bulu & Gogoat Line summon Grassy Terrain when attacked, boosting stats afterwards.

Solganium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Solgaleo's Sunsteel Strike to a Z-Move.
Lunalium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Lunala's Moongeist Beam to a Z-Move.
Ultranecrozium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Necrozma's Photon Geyser to a Z-Move.
Gift Bag: Delibird's bag full of goodies. Munches on leftovers, holds Loaded Dice, Wide Lens & Z-Crystals, allowing Z-Celebrate. Grants 12 turns of lucky chant & Refrigerate.
Lycanium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Lycanroc's Stone Edge to a Z-Move.
Clanging Scale: Worn by the Kommo-o line, this enhances their fighting spirit, granting Fighting STAB & the ability Amplifier. Harnesses Z-Power to use Clangorous Soulblaze as well.
Z-Power Ring: A mysterious ring that enables Pokémon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.
Pink Petal: A pressed flower petal you receive from Mina during Mina's trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.
Orange Petal: A pressed flower petal you receive from Ilima during Mina's trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.
Blue Petal: A pressed flower petal you receive from Lana during Mina's trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.
Red Petal: A pressed flower petal you receive from Kiawe during Mina's trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.
Green Petal: A pressed flower petal you receive from Mallow during Mina's trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.
Yellow Petal: A pressed flower petal you receive from Sophocles during Mina's trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.
Purple Petal: A pressed flower petal you receive from Nanu during Mina's trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.
Rainbow Flower: A flower made of the petals you received from captains. It's proof that your growth has been recognized by them.
Surge Badge: A novelty badge that you can receive at the Kantonian Gym. Rumor has it that it imitates the Badge of a Gym somewhere.
N-Solarizer: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Solgaleo.
N-Lunarizer: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Lunala.
Ilima's Normalium Z: The Normalium Z you were entrusted with by Ilima. You were asked to place it on the pedestal at the back of Verdant Cavern.
Left Poké Ball: A Poké Ball with a Pokémon that lost its Trainer inside. It seems to be from Ula'ula Island.
Roto Hatch: One of the Rotom Powers. It helps Eggs hatch faster.
Roto Bargain: One of the Rotom Powers. It reduces the prices of products at Poké Marts by half.
Roto Prize Money: One of the Rotom Powers. It triples the prize money you receive after battle.
Roto Exp. Points: One of the Rotom Powers. It increases the Exp. Points your Pokémon receive after battle a little.
Roto Friendship: One of the Rotom Powers. It helps Pokémon in your party grow friendly faster.
Roto Encounter: One of the Rotom Powers. It increases the chance of encountering high-level wild Pokémon a lot for a certain period of time.
Roto Stealth: One of the Rotom Powers. It prevents you from encountering wild Pokémon for a certain period of time.
Roto HP Restore: One of the Rotom Powers. It fully restores the HP of your battling Pokémon.
Roto PP Restore: One of the Rotom Powers. It fully restores the PP of your battling Pokémon.
Roto Boost: One of the Rotom Powers. It raises all stats of your battling Pokémon.
Roto Catch: One of the Rotom Powers. It increases the chance to catch Pokémon a lot.
